summary: Engine abstraction shipped: TranscriptionEngine ABC (ClassVar name, transcribe, no-op close), deterministic MockEngine (size-derived duration, FAIL-stem error injection, fixed-segment override, synthetic word timestamps), lazy-importing FasterWhisperEngine (per-(model,device,compute_type) model cache, config->transcribe kwarg mapping verified against installed faster-whisper 1.2.1 where 'auto' is accepted verbatim for device and compute_type, full generator drain, EngineNotAvailableError/ModelLoadError/TranscriptionFailedError wrapping), and a registry (get_engine/create_engine/available_engines). 25 offline tests via injected fake faster_whisper module.
